releases.summary: First verified Windows package with Process Scans, RFI Log, and Batch Print.
Email-assisted RFI drafting, native Excel copy, systematic app versioning, and lightweight Windows UI artifacts.
Gemini schema, Azerbaijani mail parsing, compact tag expansion, and short item lookup fixes.
Gemini model fallback and compatibility update.
Modern and legacy Gemini structured-output compatibility.
Correct Gemini response-format MIME handling.
Workbook-backed Outlook mail-table preview and native formatted copy.
Optional flat output mode for Process Scans.
Dynamic RFI workbook mapping and Excel-native clipboard flow.
Single-pass large-workbook processing and clipboard performance fixes.
Reliable multi-RFI Excel automation and process cleanup.
Hidden, non-interactive Excel preparation until native copy completes.
Multi-sheet CIV, MEC, ELE, and PRC RFI workflow with atomic apply and undo.
Packaged sidecar startup and Windows layout compatibility fixes.
Independent per-sheet scheduling and compact copy-action layout.
MEC row-number editing and workbook-backed mail copy.
Unicode-safe RFI lookup transport and production workbook validation.
Flutter-era trial of resumable guided batch printing; preserved for traceability.
First Tauri migration preview with the Python engine and signed-page staging.
Tauri 2 production baseline with complete v0.5.4 workflows, resilient printing, compact RFI editing, and safe signed-page staging.
Release candidate with exact RFI Follow Up synchronization, unsent Outlook Reply All drafts, redacted local diagnostics, and commit-bound Windows evidence.
Automated Windows cross-build with bundled OCR, HTML5 drag-and-drop on form path inputs, persistent parameter auto-save and reuse, flexible RFI header layout discovery, and 1-click diagnostic export.
Power-user UX accelerators: live preview table text search and filter tabs (All, Changes, Manual Review) plus keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Space, Escape).
High-contrast monochrome dark mode adhering to Rule 11 with obsidian backdrop, crisp card borders, 1-click header theme switcher, and Alt+T hotkey.

UI/UX layout overhaul: eliminate button overlap, fix unclosed dark media query, decouple table action headers from column count, dock action bars without covering form fields, auto-close date dropdowns, and add 1-click path reset.

Fix unknown workbook relationship class error in Worley signature synchronization by expanding OOXML relationship resolution to support modern Microsoft Office schemas and standard Excel workbook relationships.
Fix 'More than one safe Follow Up table was found' error by adding multi-sheet layout discovery and preferred discipline sheet disambiguation in Worley signature status synchronization.

Implement Analyze RFI System & Sync Worley Signatures feature (rfi.system_sync) scanning discipline folders (CIV, MEC, ELE, PRC), detecting Worley signature box on page 1, updating RFI Log REMARKS to 'Signed by Worley', and adding Final ITP short codes into Follow Up Signed by CIV and Signed by MEC sheets with full atomic backup and undo.

Fix 'path grant does not allow this access' and plan reservation errors in RFI System Sync: dynamic ReadWrite root promotion for workbooks nested inside system folder, write-intent grant resolution, and provisional grant committing.

Prevent RFI workbook repair by discovering current REMARKS and Worley control headers, guarding exact literal cells, preserving existing remarks, verifying closed OOXML deltas, rejecting stale plans, and supporting per-RFI revision.
Add read-only device readiness for OCR, printers, and recovery work; reconcile product documentation; and accept the offline-first RFI work-item lifecycle boundary.
Promote device readiness to its correct backward-compatible feature release and enforce tested PATCH, MINOR, and MAJOR version selection for future work.
Add owner-scoped append-only RFI work items, Today/Resume/Needs Review queues, strict canonical identifiers, conflict detection, and fully journaled create/transition/undo behavior.
Open RFI work items directly from Today, Resume, and Needs Review with safe prefilled transitions and schema-enforced transient task fields.
Localize the shared back action and preview-first safety badge across all four supported languages.
Link RFI work progression to exact committed local journals for RFI Log, filed scans, and two-workbook Worley synchronization, with stale evidence sent to review.
Export owner-scoped RFI work history as lossless JSON and Excel-safe CSV through the no-clobber journal boundary, with visible bounded-store capacity.
